queries: WITH sex_counts AS (SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(*) AS exam_count FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), overall AS (SELECT SUM(exam_count) AS total_count, AVG(exam_count) AS average_count FROM sex_counts) SELECT SUM(s.exam_count) AS total_examinations, AVG(1.0 * s.exam_count / o.total_count) AS average_share, AVG(s.exam_count - o.average_count) AS average_excess FROM sex_counts AS s CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE s.exam_count > o.average_count;

WITH sex_counts AS (SELECT p.SEX, COUNT(*) AS exam_count FROM Examination AS e JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), totals AS (SELECT AVG(exam_count) AS avg_count, SUM(exam_count) AS total_count FROM sex_counts) SELECT SUM(c.exam_count) AS total_count, AVG(1.0 * c.exam_count / t.total_count) AS average_share, AVG(c.exam_count - t.avg_count) AS average_excess FROM sex_counts AS c CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE c.exam_count > t.avg_count;
